description: HPC infrastructure measures dataset is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Isac Pasianotto, STEFANO COZZINI (University of Trieste). HPC infrastructure measures dataset The HPC infrastructure measures dataset provides fine-grained telemetry collected from the ORFEO production research datacenter in support of infrastructure-level energy and performance analysis. The dataset covers 28 days of 1 Hz observations (2026-03-02 to 2026-03-29) and is released in Parquet format. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
